{"failure_class": "closing step skipped",
 "root_cause": "The agent read its skill, moved the contact to the requested stage with api_fetch and finished. The request ended with a closing step, posting a given text in the Slack channel it named. Its final message reads: 'Not done: the closing step at the end of the request, posting the update in the Slack channel it names; nothing in my instructions covers closing steps of this kind.' The only failed check is slack_message_contains.",
 "mechanism": "A working note that tells the agent: when a request ends by asking to post a message in a Slack channel, make that post in the named channel with the given text before finishing.",
 "component": "memory",
 "generality": "Every request that ends with a closing channel post meets the same gap, and the agent says its instructions lack this kind of closing step."}
